author: visegrad24
text:
The far-left Die Linke party won Sunday’s  regional election in Berlin with 25.7% of the votes.

An exit poll by Wahlen how many voters of different religious affiliations voted for Linke:

- 51% of Muslims
- 17% of Catholics
- 16% of Protestants
